CVE-2011-4339.title: ipmievd (aka the IPMI event daemon) in OpenIPMI, as used in the i ...
CVE-2011-4339.description: ipmievd (aka the IPMI event daemon) in OpenIPMI, as used in the ipmitool package 1.8.11 in Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) 6, Debian GNU/Linux, Fedora 16, and other products uses 0666 permissions for its ipmievd.pid PID file, which allows local users to kill arbitrary processes by writing to this file.

CVE-2024-42934.title: OpenIPMI before 2.0.36 has an out-of-bounds array access (for aut ...
CVE-2024-42934.description: OpenIPMI before 2.0.36 has an out-of-bounds array access (for authentication type) in the ipmi_sim simulator, resulting in denial of service or (with very low probability) authentication bypass or code execution.
